description: A real DMR direct-mode call (sdrmm dmr_call_48k) at +6 kHz from a 446.18775 MHz centre, as in run 8: the channel sits next to the DC spike. Upsampled by the polyphase resampler only, with one fixed gain (no AGC, DC removal or ramps), so the 30 ms TDMA bursts keep their timing and keying gaps.
